SUBJECTS_flora_legibility.lead_html: Flora legibility grading (FLORA_LEGIBILITY_BAR_1). 119 of our 374 shipped plants (one per picture, split by size: 18 tree, 22 clump, 79 single). For each row, pick Works / Borderline / Mud for the picture the game draws, at true scale. Nothing is pre-filled. Column picks and notes work as on any art sheet but are optional here. A row you skip simply stays ungraded; the model is fitted from the rows you grade.

question.label: Legibility at true scale
question.explain: Grade the picture the game draws (the runtime-live column) at its true in-game size beside the human: does the plant read? Works / borderline / mud. No keyline is expected on flora (vanilla convention, measured 2026-09-13); judge value/shape contrast and silhouette. These grades fit the flora legibility model (FLORA_LEGIBILITY_BAR_1). Nothing is pre-filled.
